title: B.Tech Admission — SRMJEEE
content: SRM Institute of Science and Technology (SRMIST) admits students to B.Tech programs through SRMJEEE (SRM Joint Engineering Entrance Examination). Candidates must have passed 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics with a minimum of 60% aggregate. The entrance exam tests Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, and optionally Biology. Slot booking for counselling is done online post results.

title: B.Tech Fee Structure
content: The annual tuition fee for B.Tech programs at SRMIST Kattankulathur varies by specialisation. Computer Science and Engineering (CSE) is approximately ₹3,00,000 per year. Mechanical, Civil, and Electrical Engineering are approximately ₹2,50,000 per year. Specialisations like AI & ML, Data Science, and Cyber Security may have higher fees around ₹3,50,000 per year. Hostel and mess charges are separate, ranging from ₹80,000 to ₹1,20,000 per year.

title: Placements at SRMIST
content: SRMIST has a strong placement record. In 2023-24, over 8,000 students were placed. Top recruiters include Amazon, Microsoft, Google, Infosys, TCS, Wipro, Cognizant, Zoho, PayPal, and Deloitte. The highest package offered was ₹1.2 Crore per annum. The average package for CSE students is approximately ₹6-8 LPA. The Career Development Center facilitates placements through mock interviews, aptitude training, and company tie-ups.

title: Campus and Hostel Facilities
content: The SRMIST Kattankulathur campus spans over 250 acres. Facilities include air-conditioned hostels (separate for boys and girls), a multi-cuisine food court, sports complex with a swimming pool, gymnasium, cricket ground, basketball and volleyball courts, a 24/7 medical centre, and a central library with over 1 lakh volumes. High-speed Wi-Fi covers the entire campus. The campus also has an ATM, bank branches, convenience stores, and laundry services.

title: Departments and B.Tech Specialisations
content: SRMIST offers B.Tech in the following specialisations: Computer Science and Engineering (CSE), CSE with AI & ML, CSE with Data Science, CSE with Cyber Security, CSE with Cloud Computing, Information Technology, Electronics and Communication Engineering (ECE), Electrical and Electronics Engineering (EEE), Mechanical Engineering, Civil Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, and Biotechnology.
